name: ascendkit
description: TypeScript toolkit for the Ascend launchpad on Elysium testnet: SDK, simulator, indexer, CLI and Telegram bot

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ascendkit/core && npm run build -w @ascendkit/sim && npm run build -w @ascendkit/indexer && npm run build -w @ascendkit/cli && npm run build -w @ascendkit/bot
